refunds.body: In the bookings list, open the side panel and check the cancellation policy (more than 48 h before = 100%). Click “Refund” to record the entry in the ledger.

commissions.title: How do commissions and escrow work?
commissions.body: Money paid by guests is held in escrow until the service is delivered. Commissions (10% to 18%) are deducted automatically when the provider is paid.

staysVsHotels.title: Private accommodation vs. hotel / hostel
staysVsHotels.body: Hotels and youth hostels have several room types (private room or dorm bed) and are classified by stars or an official hotel licence.

dzd.definition: The only currency used for prices and payouts on the platform. All accounting entries use DZD.

escrow.definition: Guarantee mechanism that holds payments until the day after check-in or the start of the activity.

individualHost.definition: A private person renting a room in their home, a villa or a furnished apartment.

travelAgency.definition: A professional company holding a licence approved by the Ministry of Tourism to organise tours.

guests.description: Renamed “Guests” to use the language of our marketplace. Manage guest profiles, booking history and accounts.

onboarding.description: Configure the identity documents and verification steps required for individual hosts, agencies, hotels and hostels.

auditLog.location: Sidebar > Manage > Settings > History of actions
auditLog.description: Complete chronological timeline of all staff decisions, wallet top-ups and approvals.

money.description: Host wallets, CCP / bank top-ups, DARNA commission earnings and payout approvals.

team.description: Manage staff accounts, moderator access, finance officers and supervisor roles.

disputes.location: Sidebar > Bookings (Disputes tab) or Home card
disputes.description: Inspect booking conflicts, review evidence and decide on guest refunds or host payouts.

gmv.definition: The total paid in Algerian dinars by guests for all stays and experiences.
gmv.howItIsCounted: Sum of nightly rates, cleaning fees and service charges across confirmed bookings.

commission.definition: The platform service fee kept by DARNA to run support, servers and marketing.
commission.howItIsCounted: The platform commission rate (e.g. 10% to 15%) applied to each booking.

bookingsCount.definition: Total reservations made by guests for family stays, hotels or Sahara trips.
bookingsCount.howItIsCounted: Count of all confirmed, in-progress and completed guest reservations.

newHosts.definition: New Algerian individuals, tourism agencies, hotels and hostels that joined DARNA.
newHosts.howItIsCounted: Count of newly registered and approved host profiles during the period.

occupancy.plainTerm: Nights booked out of nights available
occupancy.definition: Share of calendar nights on which accommodation listings were occupied by guests.
occupancy.howItIsCounted: (Nights booked ÷ total nights available on host calendars) × 100.

cancellationRate.definition: Share of reservations that were cancelled before check-in.

payout.definition: Net funds transferred to a partner's bank or CCP account after the DARNA commission.

auditLog.definition: Chronological record of every administrative action, approval and balance adjustment.

onboardingConfig.definition: The documents and profile questions hosts must complete before going live.

pendingReview.definition: An application or listing waiting for a staff moderator to review and decide.

users.definition: Algerian and international travellers who book stays and tours on DARNA.

welcome.title: Welcome to the DARNA Admin Console
welcome.description: Designed for effortless, safe moderation. You can understand the health of DARNA in under 10 seconds and reach any task in 3 clicks or less.

home.title: 1. Home & needs your attention
home.description: The top of the dashboard highlights urgent tasks (hosts waiting for approval, listings to review, disputes). Each card takes you directly to the filtered queue in 1 click.

approvals.title: 2. “To review” approvals inbox
approvals.description: Click “To review” in the sidebar at any time. The red badge shows how many items are waiting. Check documents and approve or reject with helpful guidance.

search.title: 3. Instant search anywhere (⌘K)
search.description: Press ⌘K or click the search bar at any time to jump instantly to any host, guest, booking or Algerian wilaya.

help.title: 4. Languages & contextual help (?)
help.description: Switch between French, Arabic (full right-to-left) and English. Press ? or open Help on any page for step-by-step guides and the words used.
